title: Gravix v1.0.0
subtitle: CNC · Laser · Plotter · Pencil
scTools: R / C / E: drag to draw rectangle, circle, ellipse
scDraw: L: line · A: arc · B: curve · D: dimension · M: measure
scNodes: N: edit nodes of the selected object
scSnap: G: grid snap · S: geometric snap
scOrtho: O or F8: ortho/polar (Shift inverts it while drawing)
scZoom: + / -: zoom · Ctrl+0: fit view · Ctrl+Shift+0: zoom to selection
scEdit: Ctrl+X/C/V/D: cut, copy, paste, duplicate · Ctrl+Z: undo
